parameters.rule: P_i=s*C_i+K_j mod29, j advances only at active positions. s in{1,-1}. Skip positions copy F=0 and consume no key.
parameters.periods: 1..16, with1 as affine baseline; candidate final key reduced to primitive period. No dictionary keys or plaintext cribs supplied.
parameters.historical_controls: Actual source-anchored LP1-03_04_divinity and LP1-14_15_circumference ciphertexts, but supply their documented skip positions as an ORACLE. Recover key and plaintext; this does NOT test interruption discovery. Same signs and periods, only oracle policy.
parameters.external_controls: First2 paragraphs in each of chaptersX,XI,XII with>=200 runes; take first200. Inject uniform independent keys of lengths5 and13 respectively using Random(3301038), signs+1 and-1 respectively, no skips. Search both unknown policies, both signs, all periods.
parameters.model: Order4 BackoffModel alpha0.5 strength5. Training ONLY Emerson chaptersI,III,IV,V,VI,VII,VIII,IX, same source-rune encoding as E030. Order2 marginal from same fitted model for warmup. No LP training. Holdout chapters were seen historically, so not a fresh blind corpus.
parameters.objective: (sum order4 log probabilities - primitive_key_length*log29)/full_rune_count. Fixed description-length criterion, not calibrated posterior probability. Uniform sign/period/policy constants omitted because common. During each fixed-period coordinate sweep optimize language likelihood only; rank final candidates with penalty.
parameters.optimizer: For each sign/policy/period:4 starts (unigram column maximum; half-columns perturbed;2 uniform random). Each at most12 cyclic coordinate sweeps under order2 then12 under order4; all29 values per coordinate; accept gain>1e-12, stop after unchanged sweep. Every changed coordinate rescored using all affected conditional factors, including copied F context. No annealing or candidate tuning.
parameters.null_diagnostic: Three independent exact-count/doublet rejection shuffles of first external control, seeds3302038+k, max100000 proposals, full identical optimizer. No inferential p-value from this capability diagnostic.
parameters.gate: All2 oracle historical controls AND all6 source-excluded external synthetic controls exact top1. Failure blocks unknown scan. Success permits a separately preregistered E039 with all55unknown pages,19 matched full-optimizer nulls of frozen maximum, plus-one p and Bonferroni55.
parameters.memory: One process; at most1024runes,16key positions,29coordinate-neighbor rows. Dense29^4 lookup;4starts; bounded24sweeps per start. Retain best candidate per sign/policy/period plus top3.
parameters.limits: Heuristic29^period search, not exhaustive. None/all_F policies do not cover arbitrary interrupter subsets; oracle controls must not be described as recovery of those subsets. Negative result applies only to declared optimizer and policies.
